rules: v0.5.1 is frozen. Do not tune it using 2026 games.
Games that kicked off before the v0.5.1 production tag timestamp are excluded from the prospective sample.
Actual play outcomes are stored separately from the pre-snap model snapshot.
A single strange game can trigger review, never automatic retuning.
No v0.6 model work is eligible before the minimum sample sizes are met, except for data-integrity or software bugs.
nfl4th unavailable/null options are treated as unavailable, never as 0% win probability.
Strong model/reference disagreements remain REVIEW evidence, not proof that either model is ground truth.
